text:
maria (AE): Kicking off a quick presales thread for VeridianAPI -> Redwood swap POC. Customer wants parity on prompt/response semantics and clarity on billing/rate limits. Can SEs confirm what test artifacts we need?

liam (SE): Thanks — we need their canonical prompt set (10–20 examples), expected response anchors, and SDK call samples. Also need traffic shape (qps, avg tokens/request).

sophia (Solutions Eng): I can take the prompt/response diff evals. Recommend we run: 1) deterministic prompt parity checks, 2) stochastic diversity samples, 3) latency p95 under their QPS.

alex (Infra): Heads up on networking: for their staging cluster we'll need IP allowlist for our Dedicated pool and a small NAT egress exception for metrics. Also confirm whether they require private deployment (VPC) or Hosted API.

maria (AE): They're leaning Hosted first, but may require VPC for production. Also they asked about proration on committed Dedicated credits if they switch mid-term — can finance confirm rough guidance? :thinking_face:

liam (SE): For the POC I'll spin up a compatibility shim that maps Veridian payloads to our API. Quick curl sample for their QA team to hit our shim:```bash
curl -X POST https://redwood.test/compat/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <POC_KEY>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"veridian_prompt":"Summarize: ...","max_tokens":256}'```This should return a JSON with fields mapped to their expected keys.

eve (Security): Please append an initial security packet: basic SOC2 checklist, data residency options, and SSO/SAML support. Also ask the customer to fill the vendor security questionnaire; I'll pre-fill answers for infra and runtime controls.

sophia (Solutions Eng): For parity metrics I'll produce a short report with: token-level delta, top-3 response divergence examples, and a prompt-anchored BLEU/ROUGE if they want. Estimated effort: 1-2 days for the smoke eval once we have their sample set.

maria (AE): Timeline check — customer hopes for a POC demo next Wednesday EOD. Is that feasible?

liam (SE): If we get assets today (prompts, sample responses, traffic profile) I can have shim + smoke run by Tuesday. Need @alex to provision a POC key and route to Dedicated staging or hosted test endpoint.

alex (Infra): I can provision the POC key and temporary IP rule today. Will need the external CIDR they test from. Also note: if they push heavy seq lengths we should advise a quantized model variant to keep p95 under 500ms.

maria (AE): Great — I'll request assets now and ask for CIDR. One more: they pinged about token billing differences vs Veridian — any quick talking points?

sophia (Solutions Eng): Short pitch: Redwood bills per output token + optional embedding/compute units; we can show cost delta with their sample workloads. Also offer Optimize run to recommend batching/quantization to cut unit cost ~25–40% depending on workload.

maria (AE): Perfect. I'll loop in the customer, request artifacts, and share the curl snippet. Thanks all :rocket:

deploy-bot: New POC key created: poc-1728888888 — expires in 14 days. (provisioned by alex)

alex (Infra): POC key attached to staging route and IP allowlist applied. Ping me if they need a private VPC alternative.

maria (AE): Closing loop — doc this thread as the official presales thread for this deal. We'll iterate if anything else pops up.
